q.q: 6 students Hina, Imran, Omar, Sadia, Salman, Waqar each have a test on a different day, from Monday to Saturday (one test per day). Sadia's test is held earlier in the week than Hina's. Omar's test is held on a day between those of Waqar and Salman. Hina's test is held earlier in the week than Imran's. Sadia's and Salman's tests are not on consecutive days. Waqar's test is held on a day between those of Imran and Omar. Exactly 3 days separate Hina's test and Salman's. Exactly 3 days separate Sadia's test and Omar's. On which day is Imran's test held?
q.e: Place the definite clues first (immediate neighbours, ends), then use the 'between' and 'left of' clues to fix the rest; the arrangement is unique.

q.q: 6 persons Asad, Bilal, Farah, Kamran, Nida, Sadia live on 6 different floors of a building, numbered 1 (ground) to 6 (top), one person per floor. Farah lives neither on the ground floor nor on the top floor. Asad lives either on the ground floor or on the top floor. Nida and Sadia live on consecutive floors. Nida lives on a lower floor than Bilal. Kamran lives on a lower floor than Farah. Exactly 4 floors lie between the floors of Asad and Sadia. Kamran lives on a floor between those of Asad and Bilal. Who lives on floor 1?
q.e: Place the definite clues first (immediate neighbours, ends), then use the 'between' and 'left of' clues to fix the rest; the arrangement is unique.
